name: flaggems_scatter_reduce
description: torch.scatter_reduce (scatter.reduce / .two overload) extracted from FlagGems tests/test_scatter_reduce.py. Scatters src values into a copy of inp along `dim` at positions given by index, reducing with sum/prod/mean/amax/amin; include_self toggles whether inp participates. index and src share the same shape and index values lie in [0, inp.size(dim)); correlated tensors are built by a custom generator. Reference mirrors to_reference(..., upcast=True): inp and src are upcast to float64 on the reference path while candidate dtypes are preserved. Contention/duplicate-index behaviour is reproduced via small output dims rather than special index patterns.
reference:
import torch


def _dtype(dt):
    return getattr(torch, dt) if isinstance(dt, str) else dt


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    inp_shape = tuple(ctx["inp__shape"])
    src_shape = tuple(ctx["src__shape"])
    inp_dtype = _dtype(ctx["inp__dtype"])
    src_dtype = _dtype(ctx["src__dtype"])
    dim = ctx["dim"]
    ndim = len(inp_shape) if len(inp_shape) > 0 else 1
    d = dim % ndim
    size_dim = inp_shape[d] if len(inp_shape) > 0 else 1
    inp = torch.randn(inp_shape, dtype=inp_dtype, device=device)
    src = torch.randn(src_shape, dtype=src_dtype, device=device)
    index = torch.randint(0, max(size_dim, 1), src_shape, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
    return {"inp": inp, "index": index, "src": src}


def run(inp, dim, index, src, reduce, include_self):
    return torch.scatter_reduce(
        inp,
        dim,
        index,
        src,
        reduce=reduce,
        include_self=include_self,
    )


def run_correctness(inp, dim, index, src, reduce, include_self):
    output = torch.scatter_reduce(
        inp.float(),
        dim,
        index,
        src.float(),
        reduce=reduce,
        include_self=include_self,
    )
    return output.to(inp.dtype)
